subject: Request to bridge procurement gap — extend demo window
messages:
From: Luis Moreno <luis.moreno@aegishealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement hold — can we keep the demo live for another two weeks?

Hi Neha,

Quick update from my side — our procurement team put a temporary freeze on new vendor spend while they rework our vendor onboarding for Q3. The tech team loves the Redwood inference tests we ran; we have a PO drafted but it’s stuck in routing and legal needs a quick SOW tweak.

Do you have any flexibility to keep our demo environment live or provide a small top-up of credits for two more weeks? The demo is mission-critical for our exec review next Thursday. If you can bridge the gap it would keep momentum.

I attached a screenshot from procurement showing the routing state.

Appreciate any help —
Luis
Director, Architecture
Aegis Health

Attachments: Aegis_PO_status.png (image stub)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Luis Moreno <luis.moreno@aegishealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement hold — can we keep the demo live for another two weeks?

Hi Luis — thanks for the update and for sharing the procurement screenshot. Great to hear the team is seeing value.

We can do a short-term bridge while the PO completes. I can provision a 7-day credit top-up and pause the demo timer to keep the environment available for your exec review. To approve anything longer than 7 days I need a quick internal sign-off (the extension team needs to confirm seat/usage risk).

Two quick asks so I can move this forward immediately:
- Confirm the PO number (or expected PO date) and basic order value (ballpark is fine).
- Can you confirm there are no additional PII/data collection tests planned during the extension?

If you can reply with those two items I’ll request the 7-day grant and loop in Ben for expedited approval if you need more runway.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Luis Moreno <luis.moreno@aegishealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement hold — can we keep the demo live for another two weeks?

Neha — thanks. PO is drafted as PO-45821; total order value ~USD 28k. Procurement says routing should finish in ~10 business days barring further questions. No new PII tests — we’re only exercising inference latency and throughput against anonymized data.

If it helps, I can ask procurement to flag this as an executive priority but that may add overhead. A 7-day pause would keep us through the exec review, but if there’s any chance you can approve a 14-day bridge it would give us room in case routing slips.

Appreciate you and the team for helping keep this live.

—Luis

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Moreno <luis.moreno@aegishealth.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement hold — can we keep the demo live for another two weeks?

Looping in Camila for policy/credit approval. Neha — based on what Luis shared: PO-45821, ~$28k, no PII activity. From a risk standpoint this is low.

Camila — would you ok a 14-day temporary credit top-up for Aegis? If you prefer, we can do a 7-day automatic grant and a manual 7-day follow-up if procurement still hasn’t cleared.

If you approve, I’ll prepare the demo addendum and send Luis the confirmation.

Thanks,
Ben
Director, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Luis Moreno <luis.moreno@aegishealth.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 14:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement hold — can we keep the demo live for another two weeks?

Thanks for the context. Ben / Neha — I reviewed the account history and PO draft. Given the deal size and that there’s no PII testing planned, I’m comfortable approving a one-time 14-day bridge.

Neha — please provision the 14-day credit top-up, attach the demo addendum (no-cost, temporary) to the account, and set a reminder for finance to reconcile once PO-45821 lands. Luis — we’ll send the addendum for your records.

Neha — I’m attaching a fillable addendum template I use for these cases (demo-addon-addendum.pdf). Use that and mark it as temporary extension: 14 days, no additional seats, non-billable. Finance will mark it pending and close once the PO clears.

Camila Reyes
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-addon-addendum.pdf (pdf stub)
